courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring railway and transport systems through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 長焊鋼軌應力放散
related.titleEn: Stress neutralization of continuously welded rail
related.transfer: 可遷移「平移偏差合成」與「水準閉合分配」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；長焊鋼軌應力放散的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Translation-error magnitude" and "Levelling closure allocation" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Stress neutralization of continuously welded rail must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦多點測量調整閉合與誤差傳播；長焊鋼軌應力放散則以連續焊軌中性溫度約束與位移證據為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on multi-point survey adjustment closure and uncertainty propagation; Stress neutralization of continuously welded rail centres on neutral temperature restraint and displacement evidence in welded rail, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「平移偏差合成」與「自由鋼軌伸長」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到長焊鋼軌應力放散，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「中性溫差反算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Translation-error magnitude” and “Free rail expansion”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Stress neutralization of continuously welded rail, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Neutral-temperature difference inversion", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 預鑄軌道板精調
history.titleEn: Precision alignment of precast track slabs
history.text: 本課把預鑄軌道板精調放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。軌道板精調把控制網、板體剛體位姿與扣件調整串接；若控制點與板上測點的座標基準不一致，精密讀值仍會導致錯誤的實際位置。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。
history.textEn: The course places Precision alignment of precast track slabs in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Slab alignment connects a control network, rigid-body pose and fastening adjustment; precision readings still give the wrong physical position when control and slab coordinates use different datums. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「平移偏差合成」到「重測平均不確定度」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Translation-error magnitude" through "Repeated-survey mean uncertainty" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
